title: A behaviour-preserving change is not a cut
situation: The operator and architect, 2026-10-13: the industry already names both ideas, so the record addresses them by those names rather than describing them. Every change, however mechanical, went through a cut with examples, illustration and assayers, because nothing in the workflow said otherwise.
decision: A change that preserves behaviour and adds or alters no meaning (a refactor, chore, docs or style change, in the industry's words) is not a cut: it is ordinary engineering, made by one agent, checked by the project's check, and reviewed by pull request. The ceremony of a cut is for changes to meaning.
consequences: The proportionality concept says the same.
